pages.text: Welcome to akaishi tech — the home of "Akaishi Energy", the red cousin of electricity.$(br2)In short, you have to feed it before you can do anything useful. Remember this food chain:$(li)$(2,4)Generate$(0): Energy Generator, Assembly, Super Architecture, Reactor, Fusion Reactor (each step costs more hair)$(li)$(2,4)Store$(0): Energy Cells, Serializer (the piggy bank itself)$(li)$(2,4)Transport$(0): Energy Pipes (the grid — don't wire it backwards)$(li)$(2,4)Carry$(0): Portable Cells (a power bank with legs)$(br2)One line to live by: power first, ores second, and only then your fortune.
